name: tr-address-neighbourhoods
title: Neighbourhoods and postal codes of Türkiye
description: Neighbourhoods (mahalle) of Türkiye with their PTT postal codes, by province and district. Built from the PTT Posta Kodu Sorgulama API (https://www.ptt.gov.tr/posta-kodu): one row per distinct neighbourhood–postal-code pair. Street-level rows from the API are aggregated. 254 neighbourhoods share more than one postal code and appear once per code.

sources.title: PTT Posta Kodu Sorgulama API (POST /api/posta-kodu actions ilceler and postakodu): neighbourhood names and postal codes for all 81 provinces and 973 districts, retrieved 2026-11-16. Public query service at https://www.ptt.gov.tr/posta-kodu.
tr-address-districts: district name spelling aligned to the Ministry / TÜİK list used in this repository

fields.name: province_code
fields.description: Two-digit province code. References code in tr-address-provinces.

fields.name: district_name
fields.description: District name as in tr-address-districts (official spelling and casing). Together with province_code identifies the district.

fields.name: neighbourhood
fields.description: Neighbourhood name as published by PTT (often ending with MAH.).

fields.name: postal_code
fields.description: Five-digit PTT postal code for this neighbourhood (or one of them when a neighbourhood has several).
